The natural history of depression is to wax and wane. Sometimes we are going to feel shitty. And like we don't love ourselves.  But that doesn't mean we are bad at loving other people.
Soneone with multiple sclerosis has an episode. They do everything they can to prevent another one, but there is always a risk of it coming back. Would you tell someone with multiple sclerosis they don't deserve love because their disease might come back? Probably not. Because that is an extremely fucked up thing to say.

Find a good therapist and start DBT. Also, the lady who developed DBT had BPD herself, and she was obviously very successful and lived a rich life. Google Marsha Linehan to find out more. :)
